title: Bare Bones Barely Drops
description: A pack that adds Tiny Takeover and Chaos Cubed support to Bare Bones!
body:
Hi! I’m Pochilito! A moderator at Bare Bones Discord and creator of Bare Bones & Stuff! Robot has been pretty busy and I really needed the new textures to keep working on my project, so I ended doing the textures for both Tiny Takeover and Chaos Cubed drops! I did my best to make the new textures fit with the color palette and be as accurate as they can to the promo artwork showed recently! I hope this helps to calm the waters while Bare Bones gets updated!

![Chaos Cubed textures](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/2bb5141763be3987100f2d98f6543b48323e7485.png)

**How to use it**
- Download the original Bare Bones
- Then put this pack above it
- The new content should be there!


Please reports any bugs to me if you find them! This pack will only be updated if Bare Bones is falling behind on updates as I really enjoy making textures!
